title: Reusing Latent Speech Representations for Query-Conditioned Topic Localization in Transcripts
abstract: arXiv:2609.21844v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long transcripts are costly inputs for downstream NLP systems and often contain irrelevant context. We study query-conditioned topic localization: predicting the sentence span in a transcript that best addresses a topic-title query. To improve span localization, we reuse ASR encoder states as sentence-level representations and fuse them with textual embeddings. This lets lightweight span locators exploit speech information without running a separate audio encoder. Experiments on two public datasets show consistent gains over text-only baselines, especially under strict boundary-matching criteria. Cross-dataset experiments further indicate that the benefits are strongest for structured or semi-structured speech, while gains on spontaneous speech are limited and mixed.

translated_title: 重用潜在语音表示用于转录文本中基于查询的主题定位
translated_abstract: 长转录文本对下游NLP系统来说是成本高昂的输入，且常常包含无关的上下文内容。我们研究基于查询条件的主题定位任务：预测转录文本中最能回应主题标题查询的句子跨度。为了改进跨度定位效果，我们重用ASR编码器状态作为句子级表示，并将其与文本嵌入进行融合。这使得轻量级的跨度定位器无需运行单独的音频编码器就能利用语音信息。在两个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比纯文本基线取得了一致的性能提升，尤其是在严格的边界匹配标准下。跨数据集实验进一步表明，该方法对结构化或半结构化语音的收益最为显著，而对自发语音的收益则有限且参差不齐。
tldr: 该论文提出重用ASR编码器状态作为句子级表示并与文本嵌入融合，实现轻量级的基于查询条件的转录文本主题定位，无需单独运行音频编码器即可在结构化语音上相比纯文本方法取得一致提升。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes reusing ASR encoder states as sentence-level representations fused with textual embeddings for lightweight query-conditioned topic localization in transcripts, achieving consistent gains over text-only baselines without running a separate audio encoder, especially on structured speech.
